items.stem: A battery sensor in a remote field must last two years and send small readings hourly. Which connectivity choice fits best?

options.text: A low-power wide-area protocol designed for small, infrequent messages
options.rationale: Correct: LPWAN-style connectivity trades bandwidth for long range and very low power.

options.text: Continuous high-bandwidth video streaming over Wi-Fi
options.rationale: High-bandwidth streaming drains batteries and exceeds the need.

options.text: A wired Ethernet connection to each field sensor
options.rationale: Wiring remote field sensors is impractical and unnecessary for small readings.

options.text: Keeping the radio powered on at full strength at all times
options.rationale: Always-on full-power radio defeats the two-year battery goal.

items.explanation: Correct: LPWAN-style connectivity trades bandwidth for long range and very low power.

items.stem: Which TWO are genuine reasons to run AI inference at the edge rather than in the cloud? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Lower latency because data need not round-trip to the cloud
options.rationale: Correct: on-device inference avoids network round-trips, reducing latency.

options.text: Reduced bandwidth and better privacy by processing data locally
options.rationale: Correct: processing locally cuts data sent and can keep sensitive data on-device.

options.text: Edge devices have unlimited compute and memory
options.rationale: Edge devices are constrained; that is a challenge, not a reason.

options.text: Edge AI removes any need for security
options.rationale: Edge AI still requires security; it does not remove the need.

items.explanation: Correct: on-device inference avoids network round-trips, reducing latency.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Why is model optimisation (e.g. quantisation or pruning) often required before deploying AI to edge devices?

options.text: Edge devices have limited compute, memory and power, so models must be made smaller and cheaper to run
options.rationale: Correct: constrained hardware forces smaller, more efficient models.
Optimisation trades some accuracy for efficiency; it does not always improve accuracy.

options.text: Because edge devices cannot run any model without the cloud
options.rationale: The point of edge AI is on-device inference without the cloud.

options.text: Because larger models always transfer faster over networks
options.rationale: Larger models are harder, not easier, to deploy on constrained devices.

items.explanation: Correct: constrained hardware forces smaller, more efficient models.
